content: KeyboardEvent.key reflects the shifted character (e.g. Shift+b -> 'B'), so case-insensitive matching should lowercase both the event key and the target character before comparing. Modifier-only keys (Control, Alt, Meta, Shift, CapsLock, Tab, etc.) should be filtered out via an allowlist/regex on event.key length or an explicit ignore-set, and event.repeat should be checked to avoid re-triggering matches on held keys. event.code is layout-independent (physical position) while event.key is layout-aware (produced character) -- for a letter/number matching game, event.key is the correct signal since it reflects what the child would see printed on the key.
